summary: Shows provisioning the domain lab with git clone and vagrant up, rerunning vagrant provision on errors, and explains reaching hosts via host-only IPs or forwarded ports in the 295xx to 299xx ranges.
questions: How do I build the Windows domain test lab?
What should I do if the Ansible step of vagrant up fails?
Which forwarded port reaches WinRM HTTPS on a given lab host?

answer_card.title: Provision the Windows domain lab
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
git clone https://github.com/jborean93/ansible-windows.git
cd vagrant
vagrant up
```
Hosts provision sequentially; if the Ansible phase fails, run `vagrant provision`. Use host-only IPs with normal ports, or `127.0.0.1` with forwarded ports: RDP `295xx`, SSH `296xx`, WinRM HTTP `297xx`, WinRM HTTPS `298xx`, SMB `299xx`, where `xx` is the host's inventory index (DC = `00`). E.g. SERVER2012R2 HTTPS is `29804`.
